content.short: Cortex is an AI agent for crypto that executes onchain actions from natural language requests.
content.description: Cortex exposes an AI agent that carries out on-chain actions from plain language instructions, such as acquiring the native token needed for gas on a chain a user has just arrived on. Agent interfaces are an attempt to hide the sequencing of bridging, swapping and approvals behind a single stated goal, which is roughly the same problem intent-based protocols address from the protocol side.
content.meta: An AI agent that carries out onchain actions, including sourcing gas on a chain you have just reached.
